mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, we are seeing clear skies and 99 degrees at City Hall. We have a full moon tonight, and the ISS will be visible for one minute starting at 9:40 PM, rising over Mount Horeb and heading toward the southwest low on the horizon. Tonight will reach a low of 68 degrees with no rain predicted.

The Verona Senior Center is offering free trishaw bike rides along the Military Ridge State Trail, but remember to fill out the required liability waiver online or in person first. Also, students grades K through 12 can participate in the I Voted sticker contest to have their designs featured in the November election, with voting on top designs open through August 7.

There is plenty to do around town starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Louie, and don't forget the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market coming up this Wednesday.

In a report covering July 20 through July 27, officers handled several incidents, including an arrest on July 26 where a driver was taken into custody for an O-W-I after being stopped for traveling 97 miles per hour on the highway.
You are in luck because today's flavor is the classic Snickers Swirl. Culver's is open until 10 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
